items.headline: Charles Schwab plans to add Solana and Avalanche trading in coming months
items.summary: CoinDesk reports Charles Schwab plans to add SOL and AVAX trading to Schwab Crypto in the coming months. The expansion broadens regulated brokerage access but does not create an immediate Crypto Reca entry signal.
items.whyItMatters: Broader brokerage access can incrementally improve institutional and retail accessibility for SOL and AVAX.
items.actionReason: Institutional-access context only; positive news never creates a buy signal and the latest available Crypto Reca Radar remains stale with no executable long.

items.headline: Crypto rally cools as traders add to Fed hike bets ahead of Jackson Hole
items.summary: CoinDesk reports bitcoin trading around the high-$79,000 area while traders increased expectations of a Fed rate hike; SOL showed relative strength while several majors softened. Falling open interest still argues against reading the move as broad fresh leveraged buying.
items.whyItMatters: A hawkish repricing in rates can pressure crypto liquidity and risk appetite ahead of the Fed Chair's Jackson Hole keynote.
items.actionReason: Macro context only. The latest available Crypto Reca Radar remains Aug. 26 20:01 Madrid and had every monitored asset below ERS 70 with no executable new long.

items.headline: XRP leverage rises to seven-month high as long crowding increases liquidation risk
items.summary: CoinDesk reports CryptoQuant's estimated XRP leverage ratio on Binance near 0.21, its highest since January, with roughly $3.45B open interest and futures volume above five times spot. XRP weakness can therefore be amplified by forced long liquidations.
items.whyItMatters: Crowded leveraged longs can amplify a normal pullback through forced liquidations.
items.actionReason: Direct XRP risk warning, not an exit instruction. The latest Radar has XRP at ERS 36 / Entry 1/5 / WATCH, with no long confirmation.

items.headline: U.S. July PCE inflation remains sticky; Q2 GDP stays at 1.5%
items.summary: BEA reported July personal income +0.4% m/m, PCE +0.2% m/m and the PCE price index +3.7% y/y; Q2 real GDP remained 1.5% annualized. This remains a macro headwind context rather than a direct crypto execution signal.
items.whyItMatters: Sticky inflation can keep financial conditions restrictive and pressure risk appetite.
items.actionReason: The release window is over; Crypto Reca still has no executable new long in the latest available Radar.

items.headline: Final U.S. spot bitcoin ETF data show $232.2M net inflows on Aug. 26, extending the positive streak to eight sessions
items.summary: Farside's current table shows $232.2M net BTC ETF inflows for Aug. 26. The run from Aug. 17 through Aug. 26 is eight consecutive positive trading sessions.
items.whyItMatters: The finalized flow strengthens the institutional-demand picture.
items.actionReason: Positive ETF demand is contextual support only and cannot create a Crypto Reca entry. The latest Radar remains stale at Aug. 26 20:01 Madrid with BTC ERS 49 / Entry 1/5 / HOLD EXISTING CORE / NO ADD.

items.headline: U.S. crypto ETFs post broad inflows on Aug. 25; bitcoin streak confirmed at seven sessions
items.summary: Finalized flow data showed $314.3M net inflows for BTC on Aug. 25 alongside positive regulated-product flows across several major crypto assets.
items.whyItMatters: Broad regulated-product inflows support spot-demand context across major crypto assets.
items.actionReason: Positive flows do not create a Crypto Reca entry or override technical hard gates.

items.headline: Crypto consolidates after the weekly surge as bitcoin holds near $79,000
items.summary: CoinDesk reported BTC consolidating after a strong weekly advance, with futures open interest declining alongside the pullback. That pattern is more consistent with position unwinding than a verified build of fresh shorts.
items.whyItMatters: The rally is consolidating rather than clearly reversing, but the prior move leaves fresh longs exposed to poor location and volatility.
items.actionReason: The 20:01 Crypto Reca Radar has all six assets below ERS 70 and no executable new long.

items.headline: U.S. spot Solana ETFs extend inflow streak and cumulative demand
items.summary: U.S. spot SOL ETFs added $33.5M on Aug. 24, followed by $32.2M on Aug. 25 and $3.6M on Aug. 26 according to Farside.
items.whyItMatters: Persistent regulated-product inflows strengthen institutional-demand context for SOL.
items.actionReason: No fresh executable trigger is independently confirmed by Crypto Reca.

items.headline: Solana supply-governance status clarified: SIMD-553 approved and merged; SIMD-550 vote remains ongoing
items.summary: 21Shares confirms SIMD-553 was approved and merged by Anza and Firedancer on July 20, while SIMD-550 advanced to SGP-0002 and has been in a stake-weighted vote since Aug. 23.
items.whyItMatters: Part of the supply-policy package is already approved while the larger disinflation change remains dependent on the ongoing vote.
items.actionReason: Fundamental context only; the latest Crypto Reca Radar still has SOL below entry thresholds and no completed trigger.

items.headline: Bitcoin pulls back after the U.S. inflation release
items.summary: BTC weakened after the PCE release and later stabilized. This remains an observed market reaction, not an independent exit signal.
items.whyItMatters: The market absorbed part of the post-PCE pullback, but short-term consolidation remains active after a large weekly move.
items.actionReason: Do not infer an exit or new entry from price reaction alone; Crypto Reca risk/structure rules remain controlling.

items.headline: Ethereum researchers propose first validator-deposit step toward quantum-resistant staking
items.summary: Ethereum researchers proposed a draft redesign of the validator deposit contract to support future quantum-resistant signature systems. The proposal is early-stage and does not represent an enacted protocol change.
items.whyItMatters: The proposal addresses a long-horizon cryptographic risk to staking infrastructure but has no immediate execution implication.
items.actionReason: Early draft only; no current Crypto Reca gate should change from this item.

catalysts.headline: U.S. weekly initial jobless claims fall to 203,000
catalysts.summary: The U.S. Department of Labor reported 203,000 seasonally adjusted initial claims for the week ending Aug. 22, down 4,000 from the prior week's revised 207,000.
catalysts.whyItMatters: The release can influence short-dated rate expectations at the margin but is not classified as a HIGH/CRITICAL crypto catalyst here.
catalysts.actionReason: The scheduled release is complete and does not alter Crypto Reca execution gates.

catalysts.headline: About $6.44 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday after the rally toward $80,000
catalysts.summary: CoinDesk, citing Deribit data, reports about $6.44B of BTC options expiring Friday, creating a concentrated hedging and volatility event around major strikes.
catalysts.whyItMatters: Large concentrated open interest can force hedging adjustments and amplify price swings around key strikes into expiry.
catalysts.actionReason: At 23:23 Europe-Madrid on Aug. 27 the Aug. 28 10:00 expiry is inside 24 hours but outside the <=6h notification window. It is a volatility catalyst, not a directional signal.

catalysts.headline: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh keynote at Jackson Hole
catalysts.summary: The Federal Reserve schedule lists Chair Kevin Warsh speaking at Jackson Hole on Aug. 28 at 10:00 ET / 16:00 Europe-Madrid.
catalysts.whyItMatters: The Fed Chair's Jackson Hole keynote can materially shift expectations for rates, liquidity and risk assets.
catalysts.actionReason: At 23:23 Europe-Madrid on Aug. 27 the Aug. 28 16:00 keynote is inside 24 hours but outside the <=6h notification window. It remains context only and does not create a Crypto Reca entry.
